UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Explorer onboarding and interface preferences scoped privately to an authenticated Firebase user.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: Optional display name from Google Sign-In.

email.description: Optional verified email stored privately under owner-only rules.

tourCompleted.description: Whether the explorer has completed the 12-step Mission Training guided tour.

tourSkipped.description: Whether the explorer explicitly skipped the Mission Training tour.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest preference update.

SavedRoutePlan.title: SavedRoutePlan
SavedRoutePlan.description: A Point A -> Point B Marswalk traverse evaluation and selected candidate saved by the user.

id.description: Deterministic or UUID document identifier matching {planId}.

ownerUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the explorer who saved this route.

name.description: User-facing label for the saved Marswalk traverse.

startLon.description: Point A eastern longitude in degrees.

startLat.description: Point A planetocentric latitude in degrees.

endLon.description: Point B eastern longitude in degrees.

endLat.description: Point B planetocentric latitude in degrees.

maxSlopeDeg.description: Configured maximum traversable slope cap in degrees.

avoidDunes.description: Whether Bagnold dark sand dunes were excluded or penalized.

elevationGainM.description: Total modeled elevation ascent in meters.

maxSlopeActualDeg.description: Maximum segment slope encountered along the selected path.

TargetBookmark.title: TargetBookmark
TargetBookmark.description: Bookmarked candidate science destination with optional explorer field notes.

ownerUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the bookmark owner.

targetId.description: Science target identifier from the MARS//PATH evidence catalog.

targetName.description: Display name of the science target.

objectiveId.description: Objective identifier under which the target was saved.

note.description: Explorer field note up to 1000 characters.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest note edit.

/users/{userId}.description: Private explorer profile storing onboarding tour status and UI preferences.

/users/{userId}/routePlans/{planId}.description: Saved Point A -> Point B Marswalk route plans owned by {userId}.

/users/{userId}/targetBookmarks/{bookmar.description: Bookmarked candidate science targets and field notes owned by {userId}.
